description: Merge two pantry rows the household says are the same food. The first stops being its own row and reads as the second, which keeps its name. The food keys are the ones get_inventory gives. The household can split them again in the app.

fromFoodKey.description: Canonical lowercase key of the row that stops being its own, e.g. 'fusilli'.

toFoodKey.description: Canonical lowercase key of the row that survives and gives the merged row its name, e.g. 'pasta'.

name: merge_pantry_foods
title: Merge two pantry rows
